datasets.name: 01f7088c
queryLines:
-- ზოგადი სესხების ცხრილი და მიმოხილვა
SELECT
    f.sub_grade_code,
    f.grade_code,
    f.term_months,
    f.issue_year,
    p.purpose_group,
    CASE WHEN f.is_charged_off THEN 'Charged Off' ELSE 'Fully Paid' END AS loan_status_label,
    CASE
        WHEN f.dti IS NULL THEN 'უცნობი'
        WHEN f.dti < 10   THEN '10%-მდე'
        WHEN f.dti < 20   THEN '10-20%'
        WHEN f.dti < 30   THEN '20-30%'
        ELSE                   '30%+'
    END AS dti_band,
    f.funded_amount,
    f.is_charged_off,
    f.net_result
FROM getdata.calculated.fct_lc_loan_performance f
LEFT JOIN getdata.calculated.dim_lc_purpose p ON f.purpose_code = p.purpose_code

datasets.name: f2381662
queryLines:
-- წინასწარ დავაჯგუფეთ მონაცემები, რისკის ქვეტიოპი x ვადის დონეზე. სკატერ ჩარტისთვის და "10 სუსტი სეგმენტის"-თვის
SELECT
    f.sub_grade_code,
    f.term_months,
    COUNT(*) AS loan_count,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.is_charged_off THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS charge_off_rate_pct,
    ROUND(SUM(f.net_result) / SUM(f.funded_amount) * 100, 2) AS weighted_net_margin_pct,
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(f.net_result) / SUM(f.funded_amount) * 100 < 0
            THEN CONCAT(CAST(f.term_months AS STRING), ' - ზარალშია')
        ELSE CONCAT(CAST(f.term_months AS STRING), ' - მოგებაშია')
    END AS term_margin_group
FROM getdata.calculated.fct_lc_loan_performance f
GROUP BY f.sub_grade_code, f.grade_code, f.term_months
ORDER BY f.grade_code, f.sub_grade_code

datasets.name: fb21adbf
queryLines:
-- რისკის კატეგორიების განაწილება წლების მიხედვით 
WITH grade_lookup AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT grade_code, grade_sort_order FROM getdata.calculated.dim_lc_grade
),
base AS (
    SELECT
        f.issue_year,
        gl.grade_code,
        gl.grade_sort_order,
        COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM getdata.calculated.fct_lc_loan_performance f
    LEFT JOIN grade_lookup gl ON LEFT(f.sub_grade_code, 1) = gl.grade_code
    WHERE f.term_months = 36
    GROUP BY f.issue_year, gl.grade_code, gl.grade_sort_order
)
SELECT
    issue_year,
    grade_code,
    grade_sort_order,
    CASE
        WHEN :display_mode = 'პროცენტი'
            THEN ROUND(100.0 * loan_count / SUM(loan_count) OVER (PARTITION BY issue_year), 2)
        ELSE loan_count
    END AS display_value
FROM base
ORDER BY issue_year

datasets.name: 31e31a29
queryLines:
-- მესამე გვერდზე არსებული ქაუნთერებისთვის
SELECT
    ROUND(
        (SUM(CASE WHEN f.issue_year = 2015 THEN f.net_result ELSE 0 END)
         / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN f.issue_year = 2015 THEN f.funded_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) * 100)
        -
        (SUM(CASE WHEN f.issue_year = 2013 THEN f.net_result ELSE 0 END)
         / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN f.issue_year = 2013 THEN f.funded_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) * 100)
    , 2) AS margin_change_pp,

    ROUND(
        (100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.issue_year = 2015 AND f.is_charged_off THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
         / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN f.issue_year = 2015 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0))
        -
        (100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.issue_year = 2013 AND f.is_charged_off THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
         / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN f.issue_year = 2013 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0))
    , 2) AS charge_off_change_pp

FROM getdata.calculated.fct_lc_loan_performance f
WHERE f.term_months = 36
  AND f.issue_year IN (2013, 2015)

datasets.name: 19d8e495
queryLines:
SELECT
    sub_grade_code,
    term_months,
    loan_count,
    charge_off_rate_pct,
    weighted_net_margin_pct
FROM (
    SELECT
        f.sub_grade_code,
        f.term_months,
        COUNT(*) AS loan_count,
        ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.is_charged_off THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS charge_off_rate_pct,
        ROUND(SUM(f.net_result) / SUM(f.funded_amount) * 100, 2) AS weighted_net_margin_pct
    FROM getdata.calculated.fct_lc_loan_performance f
    GROUP BY f.sub_grade_code, f.term_months
)
ORDER BY weighted_net_margin_pct ASC
LIMIT 10
